entities.summary: Ryōzen-ji is a Shingon Buddhist temple in Naruto, Tokushima Prefecture, Japan best known as the first temple of the Shikoku pilgrimage. It is associated with the Kōyasan sect and dedicated to Shaka Nyorai. Ryōzen-ji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Asia, established in 800 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
